invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of calling metadata.clone(), so unless clone returns null, result should be non-null.
metadata is a method input and must not be null for convertMetadata to be called successfully.
The method returns HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, where the contained write statuses should be a List.
The core logic is to clone metadata with the collected list of WriteStatus, so this equality should hold.
Assuming .clone keeps the same concrete type, class equality should hold between result and metadata.
